label: Plum & Petal
description: Deep plum with a bronze accent on a barely-pink page. Feminine but built for catalogues — suits cosmetics and salon-supply retailers, beauty wholesalers, parlour equipment dealers and multi-brand product stores.
notes:
Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables.

WHY NOT 'blush-noir': that theme lists beauty among its industries, but it is an editorial ivory-and-Cormorant palette built for fashion boutiques. A salon-supply business sells chairs, wax heaters, developers and mannequin stands to working beauticians — dressing that as a luxury fashion label misrepresents what the shop is. This palette stays feminine but reads as a product catalogue.

ACCENT IS CONTRAST-CHECKED, NOT PICKED BY EYE: the renderer uses --color-accent as the colour of the 12px meta line on product cards, so it has to clear WCAG AA at small text. The obvious lighter bronze (#A66A2C) measures 4.23:1 on this background and fails; #995F26 measures 4.97:1 and passes. Primary is 8.35:1, muted 5.09:1, white-on-primary 8.77:1. Re-measure before changing the accent — a prettier gold here will quietly fail the one place it is actually used as text.
